children: Apple will hold its first major product keynote under new CEO John Ternus on September 9, with a foldable iPhone expected to headline the event at Apple Park in Cupertino. According to BeInCrypto, the lineup is also expected to include refreshed Siri AI features, the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, and updated Apple Watch models, while analysts say the presentation will test whether Apple’s hardware strength can carry into the AI era.

title: Apple’s First Foldable iPhone To Headline John Ternus Keynote On September 9
